description: asks Sonnet (the everyday model -- quick, for what we were working on or where something is) one question through rol_finances adws/adw_ask_sonnet.py and relays the line it writes
notes: Dispatcher only: the answer comes from the ask_sonnet agent in rol_finances adws/adw_sssf_config/sssf.config.yaml (read-only: read/grep/find/ls, writes []). The workflow gathers recent commits, the newest ADW runs and the handoff note into context.md before Sonnet answers, and writes one spoken line to --message-out. --follow-up continues the newest Ask Sonnet thread, so Sonnet keeps its own context. Full answers land in the run's context_handoff/answers.md.
